# Docker images the integration tests pin. The tests read each emulator's image from here
# (tests/images.py) and CI pulls every line, so each tag is declared once.
# One image:tag per line; '#' comments and blank lines are ignored. The library
# defaults stay the floating latest tag of each image.

floci/floci-az:0.15.0
floci/floci-gcp:0.11.0
floci/floci-oci:0.5.0
